* May choose to deploy both cards from hand only, without even searching Reserve Deck. But if that is not possible then Reserve Deck must be searched.
* If Reserve Deck is not searched, do not reshuffle it.
* If one or both cards cannot be found, opponent only verifies Reserve Deck. A judge may be required to verify combined contents of hand and Reserve Deck to check for the cards.
* May search Reserve Deck, then decide to deploy both cards entirely from hand (this does not trigger verification).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lothal (Errata)]]): PC errata of 12 December 2022; card image marked E1 published 12 December 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Light: Hera deploys -1 here. While Lothal converted, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” The image prints the ▲ arrow; the PC card data writes it out as “may take This is MY Ship! into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” (lower-case “is”), which is the data's notation, not a separate text. '''What changed:''' Both halves were rewritten. Light: “Ghost deploys -2 here. While Ghost piloted here, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1 here.” became “Hera deploys -1 here. Once per game, may ▲ This Is MY Ship!” Dark: “Unless Chimaera or Thrawn here, Force drain -1 here.” became “Unless Thrawn here, Force drain -1 here and This Is MY Ship! is [Immune to Sense]. While Lothal converted, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” The card gained the E1 mark.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E2 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/lothal.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/ee45248a4d6203572ea789bbbffc1a218c6ba078 swccg-card-json commit ee45248a4d] (19 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Light: Once per game, may simultaneously deploy Ghost and Hera here from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Thrawn and Pryce deploy -1 (and shuttle for free) to here. While Lothal converted, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the E1 and original texts. '''What changed:''' Both halves were rewritten again. Light: “Hera deploys -1 here. Once per game, may ▲ This Is MY Ship!” became “Once per game, may simultaneously deploy Ghost and Hera here from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” Dark: “Unless Thrawn here, Force drain -1 here and This Is MY Ship! is [Immune to Sense].” became “Thrawn and Pryce deploy -1 (and shuttle for free) to here.” (“While Lothal converted, gains one [Dark Side] icon.” kept).
